descriptions.zh: 我们必须登上这艘外星舰船。微弱的能量读数表明其中可能有一个正常运转的生命维持系统。有可能有人或什么东西潜伏在船上。我们的士兵很想知道答案。
descriptions.en: We must board the alien vessel. Faint energy readings could indicate a functioning life-support system. There is a chance that someone, or something, may be lurking on the ship. Our soldiers are eager to find out.

descriptions.zh: 这艘舰船需要进行全面维护。我们自愿支援维修工作。
descriptions.en: The alien vessel requires extensive maintenance. We have agreed to assist with repairs.

descriptions.zh: 在首都恒星系建造一座通讯中继站以避免长距离通讯受到干扰。我们最好的工程师已经准备好开展工作了。
descriptions.en: Building a relay in our capital system will prevent disruptions in long-range communications. Our best engineers are ready to get to work.

descriptions.zh: 准备一场盛大的游行，设立公休假日，这需要大量的准备工作。如果我们要重燃国家自豪感，一切都必须安排得尽善尽美。
descriptions.en: A grand parade and public holiday will require a great deal of preparation. Everything must be perfect if we are to rekindle the nation's pride.

descriptions.zh: 异见者正悄悄地在我们的军队里落地生根，他们诽谤§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!并试图谋反。我们必须采取快速而强有力的行动。
descriptions.en: Dissidents are taking root inside our military, slandering §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! and scheming against us. Swift and decisive action must be taken.

descriptions.zh: 制止内阁中的裙带关系应该是我们的首要任务，因为它几乎阻碍了我们所做的一切。清理这些腐败可能需要一些时间，但我们的人民对我们抱有期待。
descriptions.en: Putting a stop to nepotism in the council should be our top priority, as it hinders almost everything we do. It may take some time to clean up all this corruption, but our people are counting on us.

descriptions.zh: 需要花费许多时间去定出[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星上的求救信号准确的地表位置。
descriptions.en: It will take time to pinpoint the exact planetary position of the distress signal on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上发现的孩子在经历了比任何已知历史更久的冷冻期之后成功地活了下来。复苏工作需要小心谨慎的准备。
descriptions.en: The child discovered on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName] has survived a longer period of cryostasis than any in recorded history. Resuscitation will require careful and meticulous preparation.

descriptions.zh: 在艾克萨凯德斯的冷冻舱里发现的破碎部件，该遗物远超我们目前的科学理解。需要很长的时间和资源来发现其中的秘密。
descriptions.en: A broken fragment discovered in Exakeides's cryostasis capsule, this relic is well beyond our current scientific understanding. It will take a significant investment of time and resources to uncover its secrets.

descriptions.zh:
对瓦珀博恒星系中的这颗行星的初步调查证实了§Y凯德斯§!的幻视中闪现的场景。

尽管地质不稳定，但此地仍有一些相互隔绝的坚实地面。探险还是有可能进行的。

§R该特殊项目必须由§Y凯德斯§!本人施行。§!
descriptions.en:
Initial investigation of the planet in the Vapob system corroborates with the scenes glimpsed in §YKeides§!'s vision.

Though geologically unstable, there are isolated areas of firm ground. An expedition is possible.

§RThis Special Project must be researched by §YKeides§! himself.§!

descriptions.zh:
如果这颗位于塔普入恒星系的行星和§Y凯德斯§!幻视中所见的一般，那么我们在这里应该小心再小心。

§R该特殊项目必须由凯德斯本人研究。§!
descriptions.en:
If the planet in the Taprib system is anything like the one §YKeides§! saw in his vision, we should exercise extreme caution.

§RThis Special Project must be researched by Keides himself.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们在伊弗施恒星系的一颗行星上观测到一座舰船的坟场，与§Y凯德斯§!的幻视非常相似。

§R该特殊项目必须由§Y凯德斯§!本人研究。§!
descriptions.en:
A graveyard of ships, eerily similar to the one in §YKeides§!'s vision, has been observed on a planet in the Ivusheh system.

§RThis Special Project must be researched by §YKeides§! himself.§!

descriptions.zh: 重重谜题围绕着§Y凯德斯§!所复原的遗物，而这是一次解答这些谜题的尝试。这是他幻视的来源吗？如果是这样，那么这件遗物还具有什么能力呢？
descriptions.en: An endeavor to answer the questions surrounding §YKeides§!'s restored relic. Was it indeed the cause of his visions? And if so, what further powers does it possess?

descriptions.zh:
§Y凯德斯§!发起的一项特殊项目，旨在缓解瑟塞特恒星系中无人机的哨戒。

他打算用电磁场摧毁其电源。如果成功的话我们就能去到这个星系的的行星上了。
descriptions.en:
A Special Project prompted by §YKeides§!, to relieve the Sursect system's drones of their vigil.

He intends to deploy an electromagnetic field to knock out their power sources. A successful outcome should afford us access to the system's planet.

descriptions.zh: 让[beholder_planet.GetName]上的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]逐渐适应我们的存在让我们有可能靠近低语金字塔。如果他们降低对我们的警惕我们就能在他们当中自由活动，甚至会有机会进一步研究他们的物种。
descriptions.en: Acclimatizing the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] on [beholder_planet.GetName] to our presence will help us gain access to the Murmuring Monolith. If they lower their guard around us we can move freely among them, and may also have opportunities to learn more about their species.

descriptions.zh: 我们有机会研究[beholder_planet.GetName]上的远古低语金字塔了。
descriptions.en: We have an opportunity to examine the ancient Murmuring Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 通过将能量集中在低语金字塔的内部部件上，我们或许可以重现低语呢喃现象，并实现进一步的接触。
descriptions.en: By concentrating bursts of energy on the internal components of the Murmuring Monolith, we may be able to recreate the Murmuring phenomenon, and achieve further contact.

descriptions.zh: 我们应该能追踪到这个怪异通讯的源头。
descriptions.en: We may be able to trace the source of the anonymous transmissions we have been receiving.

descriptions.zh: 我们从艾莎琳那里收到的所谓礼物实际上是一种植物性细菌，且与我们所见过的任何细菌都不同。中和它将会是一个危险的挑战。然而，如果我们成功了，它将进一步加深我们对科学和医学的理解。
descriptions.en: The supposed gift we received from Azaryn is in fact a plant-based bacteria, unlike anything we've ever seen. Neutralizing it will provide a dangerous challenge. However, if we are successful, it would further our understanding of science and medicine.

descriptions.zh: 艾莎琳给我们一个任务，让我们尝试让一朵在她船上生态系统原生的巨大的花苞开花。基于初步的观测，这朵花可能对太空生物学有着极为重要的意义。
descriptions.en: Azaryn has tasked us with blooming a giant flower bud, native to her dome ship's ecosystem. Based on initial observations, this flower may be of great astrobiological significance.

descriptions.zh: 研究我们从§Y太空创生家艾莎琳§!的环境改造之核获取的样本可以提升我们对该科技的理解。
descriptions.en: Studying the sample we obtained of §YAstrocreator Azaryn§!'s terraformation nucleus could enhance our understanding of this technology.

descriptions.zh: [event_target:renowned_xenophile1.GetName]发现的兹泰格·迈尔的宝藏。
descriptions.en: The pirate treasure of Zteg-Mayr discovered by [event_target:renowned_xenophile1.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [event_target:renowned_xenophile2.GetName]发现的一支古老的船队。传言称其中有着大量财宝。
descriptions.en: An ancient convoy found by [event_target:renowned_xenophile2.GetName]. It is rumored to contain vast riches.

descriptions.zh: 舰队司令[event_target:renowned_materialist1.GetName]在这颗荒芜星球里发现的高价值合金。
descriptions.en: Valuable alloys have been discovered by Admiral [event_target:renowned_materialist1.GetName] on this barren world.
